steps.text: Waaahhh...
I'm hungry!
Where's daddy? Where did he go?
I want my daddy...! Daddy! Daddyyy!
Daddy will come get me!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: A child?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Blaze-4, Amiya-1, come in. I'm in the slums. 4th Street, building number 10. There's a child survivor, Infected.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Waaahhh...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: ...Hello.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Wh- who are you?

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Are you a Lungmenite?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I will not hurt you. I don't speak Ursine well. I am not an enemy.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Come with me. It is dangerous here.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: I can't... Uncle said to stay here.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: But I will take you to find your dad.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: You can do that?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I can do that.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You, hiding behind me, come out.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You're not with them.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You're... from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Child, stay back. Don't come closer.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Drop your weapon and come out with your hands up.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You're not here to save us?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Don't you Rhodes Islanders know what's hidden here?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We worked hard to set up this ambush... If we can't lure them in, if we can't take them out, they'll kill all of us!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You're using children as bait. You deserve to be killed.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You think this will end when we're dead?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Even if they kill us, they won't let the children go. They won't let anyone go!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: If that's all it took, we'd gladly die to save the kids!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We didn't even attack you!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Who's killing children...? The people in the black raincoats?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You've seen them, you understand! They're slaughtering everyone!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: That's no excuse. After I take you in, I will apply to have you protected.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: And we're supposed to just trust you? That crossbow of yours is a killing tool, what are you protecting?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: For now, I'm protecting your lives.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Save it. We'll deal with you, then reset our trap!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We've already got the order to form up and retreat. If we die here, it would dishonor those comrades who died to save their children!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: ...Child, take cover!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I'm still alive?
You think you'd be better off dead?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Operator Blaze?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's not like you dying would solve anything. Better keep on ticking.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: What about... the Reunion men? And the children?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Operator GreyThroat, I got you all wrong. And I'm sorry.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: The children!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I took care of the Reunion guys! I hid the kids! Just listen to me already!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: No need... as long as the children are safe.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Can you not be obnoxious for like five minutes?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: What did you get wrong about me?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I watched you stand up to fight for Infected kids. It was hella leng noi.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Your Lungmen dialect sucks.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, that's off the top of my head! But really, I thought you were just some heartless uninfected girl, joining Rhodes Island to spy on us or whatever. I got you all wrong.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: If I were a spy, this is how I'd get you to trust me. As long as you weren't stupid enough to let me bleed out...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You bandaged me?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm still an elite operator. It's my job.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Anyway, you're right.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But even if you were a spy, you still did the right thing. So I'll save this spy's life and then pack her off to Legal.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I could just run.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Let's not be stupid here. How are you gonna outrun me?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Trust doesn't mean letting your guard down. Trust means knowing what you'll do and what you won't.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If you do the right thing, I'll back you up. If you do the wrong thing, I'll correct it, or stop it, if I have to. That's trust.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Thanks, GreyThroat. You trusted me, and you corrected my wrong thoughts with your right actions.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And I'm sorry.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But you really need to work on your people skills. They didn't want to be difficult, that was a show for survival.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If you screw up, you still need to go to Legal.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Whatever.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think so... at least Blaze is trying. Leave it to her to drop her prejudices so quickly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island's elite operators have more than just their incredible combat skills. Blaze is also gifted with a gregarious personality and savoir faire. As well as her own opinions.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If you want to lead her, if you want her support, you'll have to gain her trust. And first, you have to learn how.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've fought alongside Blaze for a long time. And I think... I think you can too, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But okay... isn't good enough, is it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She puts up a carefree front, but Blaze has a complicated personality.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Give it time, keep your eyes open, and I know you can do it, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But you need to put in more work!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Learning to trust each other isn't easy, but it needs to be done.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We need your power, Doctor, and you need to win over the operators to turn those tactics of yours into reality.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's a lengthy process, but it's one you need to experience.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze is an elite operator who excels in assault operations. She doesn't have much to offer in the way of strategic thinking.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She really needs your support. Or you could think of it like she'll turn your strategies into reality on the battlefield. She's a professional.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'd say she's already cooperating.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Like, look where we are now...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our operators follow our orders out of a sense of duty, not trust.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Real trust is built on understanding. The kind Blaze is working on with GreyThroat.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Looks like we've got company. More Reunion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's give Blaze a little more room to apologize. She still needs to stick her foot in her mouth a few more times.

options: Then let's buy them some time!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's a good conversationalist, but not so great at expressing her feelings.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's really going on here is her confronting her deep-seated prejudices more than just an apology to GreyThroat.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Normal folks' prejudices against the Infected aren't a one way street... we have our own issues with the uninfected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The enemy within is just as much an enemy as the enemy without.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...We will.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Listen up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Those Reunion guys were scared out of their wits.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Neither we nor the L. G. D. can put that kind of fear into someone. They were ready to go against everything they stood for.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They met something else... But what was it out there that could do that to them?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And... will we have to fight them too?
